objective: Aislar READ_ONLY si la ausencia de GptEscritura/cava_www en R14 se debe a metadata no visible para HRLectura o a que el registro CAVAS apunta a una identidad/base inexistente en esa instancia. Obtener identidad de instancia, permisos de metadata y DB_ID/HAS_DBACCESS de cava_www. No leer secretos, no DDL/DML, no Producción.

queries.name: instance_identity
queries.sql: SELECT @@SERVERNAME AS server_name, CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('MachineName') AS varchar(200)) AS machine_name, CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('InstanceName') AS varchar(200)) AS instance_name, CAST(SERVERPROPERTY('IsIntegratedSecurityOnly') AS int) AS windows_auth_only, DB_NAME() AS current_database, ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login

queries.name: metadata_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(NULL,NULL,'VIEW ANY DATABASE') AS can_view_any_database,HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(NULL,NULL,'VIEW ANY DEFINITION') AS can_view_any_definition,HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(NULL,NULL,'ALTER ANY LOGIN') AS can_alter_any_login

queries.name: cava_visibility
queries.sql: SELECT DB_ID('cava_www') AS cava_db_id,HAS_DBACCESS('cava_www') AS has_dbaccess_cava,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.databases) AS visible_database_count
